supporting_observations.claim: The alerted HTTPS activity is attributable to C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe: the process started under leo.martins and its network events show connections through the explicit proxy.

The proxy records show CONNECT attempts to updates.pixelforge-suite.com at 13:37:50, 13:42:31, 13:47:45, 13:53:13, 13:58:15, 14:02:29, and 14:07:46 UTC. The corresponding process/network records identify PixelForge's updater for the successful connections.
The observed destination and roughly five-minute cadence match the inventoried PixelForge updater behavior, supporting a benign explanation for the alert.
The 13:42:31 attempt was rejected with proxy status 407; later attempts to the same update host succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT metadata and byte counts, not the encrypted TLS payload or the content exchanged with the update host (for example, T046-00101 and T046-00157).
The process records identify the updater path and process ID but do not establish its file hash, signature, or binary integrity (T046-00098, T046-00103).
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the contents of the encrypted sessions or independently verify the legitimacy of the updater binary.
The evidence does not establish that the updater activity delivered or executed malicious content.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM, and the host queried x7k9m2.akamaized.net. Dropbox is not among the approved services listed in the environment context; these records do not establish that a connection to the queried address occurred. This does not decide the PixelForge alert. (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00124, T046-00126, T046-00127, T046-00128)

Separate investigation: DC-NWD-01 recorded sam.okafor credential validation from WS-LMARTINS-01, followed by a network logon to WS-SOKAFOR-01 from that workstation. This is outside the alerted HTTPS activity. (T046-00023, T046-00024)

Separate investigation: FILE-NWD-01 made a connection to WS-LMARTINS-01 on RPC endpoint-mapper port 135. The records do not establish the purpose of that connection; it is not the alerted HTTPS activity. (T046-00063, T046-00067, T046-00068, T046-00069)
